blocks.zh: 學習目標 Learning Objectives
blocks.en: Learning Objectives

blocks.zh: 列舉 TR13 所定義的 16 項環境監控先決條件，並說明各條件在 EM 程序啟動前的必要性與角色分工。
blocks.en: List the 16 environmental monitoring prerequisites defined in TR13, and explain why each is necessary before the EM program starts and who is responsible for it.

blocks.zh: 說明培養基選擇的原則：SCDM/TSA 作為廣效基礎培養基的依據、中和劑的使用時機，以及 SDA 或厭氧培養基的輔助條件。
blocks.en: Explain the principles of media selection: why SCDM/TSA is used as the broad-spectrum base medium, when neutralizers are used, and the conditions under which SDA or anaerobic media are added.

blocks.zh: 理解雙溫培養策略（30–35°C / 20–25°C）的科學基礎與行業調查結論，並能比較不同培育方案的敏感度差異。
blocks.en: Understand the scientific basis of the dual-temperature incubation strategy (30–35°C / 20–25°C) and the conclusions of the industry survey, and be able to compare the sensitivity of different incubation schemes.

blocks.zh: 掌握 8.0 參考文獻的架構分類：PDA 技術報告群、國際法規指引、ISO 標準及各國藥典，作為 EM 知識體系溯源的依據。
blocks.en: Understand how the 8.0 References are organized: PDA technical reports, international regulatory guidance, ISO standards, and national pharmacopoeias, which serve as the basis for tracing the EM body of knowledge.

blocks.zh: 本頁內容索引 Contents
blocks.en: Contents

blocks.zh: 解讀與應用
blocks.en: Interpretation and Application

blocks.zh: 為什麼先決條件如此重要？
blocks.en: Why are the prerequisites so important?

blocks.zh: 環境監控不是「裝好設備就開始採樣」這麼簡單。TR13 明確列出 16 項前提作業，強調 EM 程序必須建立在完整的設施驗證、培養基資格確認、人員訓練等基礎之上，方能確保監控數據具有科學意義。
blocks.en: Environmental monitoring is not as simple as installing the equipment and starting to sample. TR13 explicitly lists 16 prerequisite activities, stressing that the EM program must be built on a complete foundation of facility qualification, media qualification, personnel training and so on, so that the monitoring data are scientifically meaningful.

blocks.zh: 比喻：蓋房子的地基
blocks.en: Analogy: the foundation of a building

blocks.zh: 16 項先決條件就如同蓋房子的地基工程。若地基不穩（如培養基未通過 GPT、採樣設備未校正、分析員訓練不足），後續的 EM 數據猶如建在沙上的建物——表面上有數據，但無法代表真實的環境狀況，更無法通過查廠審查。
blocks.en: The 16 prerequisites are like the foundation work of a building. If the foundation is unstable (for example, media that have not passed GPT, sampling equipment that has not been calibrated, or inadequately trained analysts), the EM data that follow are like a structure built on sand: there are data on the surface, but they cannot represent the true condition of the environment, and they will not withstand an inspection.

blocks.zh: 色碼分類解讀
blocks.en: Color-coded interpretation

blocks.zh: 16 項先決條件可依性質分為四類：
blocks.en: The 16 prerequisites can be grouped into four categories by nature:

blocks.zh: 設施基礎（紅）：廠房設計、HVAC IQ/OQ、HEPA 驗證、氣流量測、PQ（第 1、10、11、14、15、16 項）
blocks.en: Facility foundation (red): facility design, HVAC IQ/OQ, HEPA validation, airflow measurement, PQ (items 1, 10, 11, 14, 15, 16)

blocks.zh: 培養基與菌株（橘）：供應商稽核、培養基選擇/放行/保存期、菌種選擇與維護（第 2–7 項）
blocks.en: Media and strains (orange): supplier audit, media selection/release/shelf life, selection and maintenance of microbial strains (items 2–7)

blocks.zh: 採樣作業流程（綠）：樣品保存運輸、培育策略驗證（第 8–9 項）
blocks.en: Sampling workflow (green): sample holding and transport, validation of the incubation strategy (items 8–9)

blocks.zh: 設備與人員（藍）：設備資格確認、分析員訓練（第 12–13 項）
blocks.en: Equipment and personnel (blue): equipment qualification, analyst training (items 12–13)

blocks.zh: 查廠常見缺失
blocks.en: Common inspection findings

blocks.zh: FDA 483 觀察項目中，EM 先決條件相關缺失最常見的包括：
blocks.en: The most common FDA 483 observations related to EM prerequisites include:

blocks.zh: 培養基 GPT 未使用環境分離株（僅用 ATCC 標準菌株）
blocks.en: Media GPT not performed with environmental isolates (only ATCC reference strains used)

blocks.zh: 樣品運輸時間/溫度未經保存研究驗證
blocks.en: Sample transport time/temperature not supported by a hold-time study

blocks.zh: 採樣設備（如撞擊式空浮採樣器）未定期校正流量
blocks.en: Sampling equipment (such as impaction air samplers) not calibrated for flow rate at defined intervals

blocks.zh: 分析員資格確認記錄不完整或未定期重新訓練
blocks.en: Analyst qualification records incomplete, or analysts not periodically retrained

blocks.zh: 7.1 廠房設計：EM 的物理基礎
blocks.en: 7.1 Facility design: the physical basis of EM

blocks.zh: 廠房設計決定了潔淨室能達到的環境等級上限。再好的 EM 程序，也無法補救設計缺陷造成的結構性污染風險。
blocks.en: Facility design determines the upper limit of the environmental grade a cleanroom can achieve. No EM program, however good, can compensate for the structural contamination risk created by design flaws.

blocks.zh: 重要標準更新
blocks.en: Important standard update

blocks.zh: ISO 14698（潔淨室生物污染控制）已被 BS EN 17141:2020 取代。新舊版本的核心監控原則一致，但 17141:2020 更強調風險評估驅動的採樣計畫設計，與 TR13 整體精神相符。
blocks.en: ISO 14698 (biocontamination control in cleanrooms) has been replaced by BS EN 17141:2020. The core monitoring principles of the old and new versions are the same, but 17141:2020 places more emphasis on risk-assessment-driven design of the sampling plan, which is consistent with the overall approach of TR13.

blocks.zh: 廠房設計的 EM 相關要素
blocks.en: EM-related elements of facility design

blocks.zh: 壓差梯度：由高等級往低等級方向正壓，防止外部污染侵入
blocks.en: Pressure differential cascade: positive pressure from higher grade to lower grade areas, to prevent ingress of external contamination

blocks.zh: HEPA 過濾效率：ISO 5 / Grade A 區域須達 H14 等級（≥99.995%）
blocks.en: HEPA filter efficiency: ISO 5 / Grade A areas must achieve H14 class (≥99.995%)

blocks.zh: 換氣次數（ACH）：決定了空氣污染的稀釋與移除速率
blocks.en: Air changes per hour (ACH): determines the rate at which airborne contamination is diluted and removed

blocks.zh: 氣流型態：層流（laminar flow）vs. 亂流（turbulent flow）直接影響 EM 採樣點的代表性
blocks.en: Airflow pattern: laminar flow vs. turbulent flow directly affects how representative the EM sampling locations are

blocks.zh: 表面材質：可清潔性（cleanability）影響表面 EM 回收率
blocks.en: Surface materials: cleanability affects the recovery rate of surface EM

blocks.zh: 實務提示
blocks.en: Practical tip

blocks.zh: 新廠啟用前，ISPE Baseline Guide Vol. 3 的 commissioning & qualification (C&Q) 流程與 TR13 的 16 項先決條件形成完整閉環：廠房設計文件 → 建造驗收 → IQ/OQ/PQ → 基線採樣 → 正式 EM 程序啟動。
blocks.en: Before a new facility is commissioned, the commissioning & qualification (C&Q) process of ISPE Baseline Guide Vol. 3 and the 16 prerequisites of TR13 form a closed loop: facility design documents → construction acceptance → IQ/OQ/PQ → baseline sampling → start of the formal EM program.

blocks.zh: 7.2 培養基選擇：EM 數據品質的核心
blocks.en: 7.2 Media selection: the core of EM data quality

blocks.zh: 培養基的選擇與資格確認，直接決定了 EM 能偵測到的微生物種類與回收率。使用不適當的培養基，等同於用有盲點的探測器監測環境。
blocks.en: The selection and qualification of media directly determine which microorganisms EM can detect and at what recovery. Using inappropriate media is like monitoring the environment with a detector that has blind spots.

blocks.zh: SCDM vs. SDA — 何時需要兩者並用？
blocks.en: SCDM vs. SDA: when are both needed?

blocks.zh: TR13 指出 SCDM 本身已能支持酵母菌與黴菌生長。因此 SDA 僅作為補充選項，適用於懷疑特定真菌污染時。若藥廠常規上同時使用 SCDM 和 SDA，應在 SOP 中提供科學依據，並說明哪些情況下啟用 SDA。
blocks.en: TR13 notes that SCDM by itself can already support the growth of yeasts and molds. SDA is therefore only a supplementary option, appropriate when a specific fungal contamination is suspected. If a firm routinely uses both SCDM and SDA, the SOP should provide the scientific rationale and state under which circumstances SDA is used.

blocks.zh: 若無特殊理由，避免在所有 EM 採樣點都使用雙培養基，因為這會大幅增加培養基成本與培育作業量。
blocks.en: Unless there is a specific reason, avoid using dual media at all EM sampling locations, because this greatly increases media cost and incubation workload.

blocks.zh: 中和劑（Neutralizers）的必要性
blocks.en: Why neutralizers are necessary

blocks.zh: 表面採樣（接觸碟或棉棒）時，消毒劑殘留（如 IPA、quaternary ammonium、過氧化氫等）可能抑制微生物生長，導致假陰性結果。因此：
blocks.en: In surface sampling (contact plates or swabs), residual disinfectants (such as IPA, quaternary ammonium, hydrogen peroxide) can inhibit microbial growth and lead to false negative results. Therefore:

blocks.zh: 表面監控培養基應添加適當中和劑（如 lecithin + polysorbate 80 組合）
blocks.en: Surface monitoring media should contain an appropriate neutralizer (for example, a lecithin + polysorbate 80 combination)

blocks.zh: 中和劑本身需驗證：不抑制目標微生物、不殘留毒性
blocks.en: The neutralizer itself must be validated: it must not inhibit target microorganisms or leave toxic residues

blocks.zh: 中和劑的選擇應與現場實際使用的消毒劑品項相對應
blocks.en: The neutralizer should be selected to match the disinfectants actually used on site

blocks.zh: 培養基 GPT 的實務要求
blocks.en: Practical requirements for media GPT

blocks.zh: TR13 強調 GPT 應使用「低接種量」（low levels）——通常為 <100 CFU，以模擬實際環境中微生物數量極低的情境。若以高接種量（>1000 CFU）進行 GPT，即使培養基效能不足，也可能得到表面上通過的結果。
blocks.en: TR13 emphasizes that GPT should use "low levels" of inoculum, typically <100 CFU, to simulate the very low microbial counts found in the actual environment. If GPT is performed with a high inoculum (>1000 CFU), the result may appear to pass even when the medium performs inadequately.

blocks.zh: GPT 菌株組合應包含：
blocks.en: The GPT strain panel should include:

blocks.zh: 藥典要求的標準參考菌株（ATCC/NCTC）
blocks.en: Pharmacopeial reference strains (ATCC/NCTC)

blocks.zh: 該廠環境分離株（environmental isolates）——需定期更新，反映當前菌相
blocks.en: The site's own environmental isolates, which need to be refreshed periodically to reflect the current flora

blocks.zh: 7.3 促生長微生物的選擇
blocks.en: 7.3 Selection of growth-promotion microorganisms

blocks.zh: GPT 菌株清單並非一次設定後永久不變。TR13 明確要求依據 趨勢報告（trending reports） 定期重新評估環境分離株的代表性。
blocks.en: The GPT strain list is not set once and then left unchanged. TR13 explicitly requires that the representativeness of environmental isolates be re-evaluated periodically based on trending reports.

blocks.zh: GPT 菌株管理的生命週期
blocks.en: Lifecycle of GPT strain management

blocks.zh: 建立期：使用藥典標準菌株 + 潔淨室資格確認時分離的菌株
blocks.en: Establishment phase: use pharmacopeial reference strains plus isolates recovered during cleanroom qualification

blocks.zh: 穩定期：依據例行 EM 趨勢，每年或每季評估是否需要更新環境分離株
blocks.en: Stable phase: based on routine EM trends, evaluate annually or quarterly whether the environmental isolates need to be updated

blocks.zh: 更新觸發點：出現新型菌種、環境分離株菌相改變、或超出 Action Level 的調查結果
blocks.en: Update triggers: appearance of a new species, a change in the flora of environmental isolates, or investigation results from an Action Level excursion

blocks.zh: 傳代管理：依 USP <1117> 記錄每次傳代次數，避免菌株特性漂移（strain drift）
blocks.en: Passage control: record the number of passages each time in accordance with USP <1117> to avoid strain drift

blocks.zh: 常見缺失：只用藥典菌株
blocks.en: Common finding: using only pharmacopeial strains

blocks.zh: 部分藥廠的 GPT SOP 僅列出 ATCC 標準菌株（如 Staphylococcus aureus ATCC 6538、Aspergillus brasiliensis ATCC 16404），而未納入環境分離株。
blocks.en: The GPT SOPs of some firms list only ATCC reference strains (such as Staphylococcus aureus ATCC 6538 and Aspergillus brasiliensis ATCC 16404) and do not include environmental isolates.

blocks.zh: 這不符合 TR13 和 USP <61> 的要求，在 FDA 查廠中屬於常見 483 觀察項目。原因是標準菌株不能代表廠房中實際存在的環境微生物對培養基的敏感性。
blocks.en: This does not meet the expectations of TR13 and USP <61>, and is a common FDA 483 observation. The reason is that reference strains cannot represent the sensitivity of the environmental microorganisms actually present in the facility to the medium.

blocks.zh: 7.4 樣品保存研究與運輸
blocks.en: 7.4 Sample hold-time studies and transport

blocks.zh: 採樣結束到培育開始的這段時間，是 EM 數據完整性的潛在漏洞。若未進行保存研究驗證，無法確保採樣時捕獲的微生物，在培育前仍保持存活且可計數。
blocks.en: The period between the end of sampling and the start of incubation is a potential gap in EM data integrity. Without a hold-time study, there is no assurance that the microorganisms captured during sampling remain viable and countable until incubation.

blocks.zh: 保存研究的設計要點
blocks.en: Key design points of a hold-time study

blocks.zh: 研究範圍：從「採樣結束」到「進入培育箱」的完整鏈路，包括在無菌室內的等待時間、通過氣閘時間、運輸至實驗室的時間
blocks.en: Scope: the complete chain from the end of sampling to placement in the incubator, including waiting time inside the aseptic area, time through the airlock, and transport time to the laboratory

blocks.zh: 溫度條件：應模擬最差情境（worst case），如夏季室溫或特殊生產區的高溫環境
blocks.en: Temperature conditions: should simulate the worst case, such as summer room temperature or the high temperature of a particular production area

blocks.zh: 最長持有時間：應等同或超過實際作業中可能發生的最長間隔
blocks.en: Maximum hold time: should equal or exceed the longest interval that could occur in actual operations

blocks.zh: 接受標準：樣品持有後的計數不應顯著低於立即培育的對照組
blocks.en: Acceptance criteria: counts after the hold should not be significantly lower than those of the control incubated immediately

blocks.zh: UV 氣閘的潛在風險
blocks.en: Potential risk of UV airlocks

blocks.zh: 部分廠房的物料傳遞氣閘配備 UV 燈，用以對進出物料表面滅菌。TR13 特別警示：EM 培養基通過此類氣閘時，UV 輻射可能殺滅已捕獲的微生物，導致假陰性結果。應評估是否設計替代通道或在傳遞時關閉 UV 燈。
blocks.en: The material transfer airlocks in some facilities are fitted with UV lamps to sterilize the surfaces of materials entering and leaving. TR13 specifically warns that when EM media pass through such airlocks, UV radiation may kill the microorganisms already captured and lead to false negative results. An alternative transfer route should be considered, or the UV lamp should be switched off during transfer.

blocks.zh: 7.5 培育策略：業界最爭議的 EM 議題之一
blocks.en: 7.5 Incubation strategy: one of the most controversial EM topics in the industry

blocks.zh: 培育溫度與時間的設計，直接影響 EM 偵測的靈敏度。業界目前存在多種不同做法，TR13 並不強制規定單一方案，而是要求「科學驗證」。
blocks.en: The design of incubation temperature and time directly affects the sensitivity of EM detection. The industry currently follows a variety of practices, and TR13 does not mandate a single scheme but requires "scientific validation".

blocks.zh: 雙溫培育策略：為何先低溫後高溫？
blocks.en: Dual-temperature incubation: why low temperature first, then high?

blocks.zh: 行業調查顯示，多數公司採用「先 20–25°C（5–7 天）後 30–35°C（48–72 小時）」的順序。這樣做的科學依據：
blocks.en: The industry survey shows that most companies use the sequence "20–25°C first (5–7 days), then 30–35°C (48–72 hours)". The scientific basis for this is:

blocks.zh: 潔淨室環境中，酵母菌與黴菌通常比細菌更難偵測（生長較慢、菌落較小）
blocks.en: In cleanroom environments, yeasts and molds are usually harder to detect than bacteria (slower growth, smaller colonies)

blocks.zh: 先在低溫讓真菌充分生長，再升溫促進細菌生長，可降低細菌菌落覆蓋真菌的風險
blocks.en: Allowing fungi to grow fully at the lower temperature first, and then raising the temperature to promote bacterial growth, reduces the risk of bacterial colonies overgrowing fungal colonies

blocks.zh: 若先高溫後低溫，快速生長的細菌可能在培育盤上形成優勢，掩蓋真菌菌落
blocks.en: If the higher temperature is used first, fast-growing bacteria may dominate the plate and mask fungal colonies

blocks.zh: In Vitro vs. In Situ 的重要差異
blocks.en: Important differences between in vitro and in situ

blocks.zh: Gordon et al. (Ref. 37) 的研究提醒我們：實驗室培育條件下的最佳化結果，不一定能直接預測現場環境樣品的表現。原因包括：
blocks.en: The work of Gordon et al. (Ref. 37) reminds us that results optimized under laboratory incubation conditions do not necessarily predict the performance of samples from the actual environment. The reasons include:

blocks.zh: 環境微生物可能處於受損或亞致死（sublethally injured）狀態
blocks.en: Environmental microorganisms may be in a damaged or sublethally injured state

blocks.zh: 環境條件（消毒劑殘留、乾燥效應）影響菌株活力
blocks.en: Environmental conditions (disinfectant residues, desiccation) affect the vitality of strains

blocks.zh: 實驗室菌株（ATCC）活力通常優於實際環境分離株
blocks.en: Laboratory strains (ATCC) are usually more vigorous than actual environmental isolates

blocks.zh: 因此，培育驗證研究建議同時納入「受壓力條件下的環境分離株」作為挑戰。
blocks.en: Incubation validation studies are therefore advised to include "environmental isolates under stressed conditions" as challenges.

blocks.zh: 培育策略驗證的文件要求
blocks.en: Documentation requirements for incubation strategy validation

blocks.zh: 無論採用何種培育方案，均需以驗證研究報告支持，並在 EM SOP 或方法驗證文件中記錄：
blocks.en: Whichever incubation scheme is adopted, it must be supported by a validation study report and documented in the EM SOP or the method validation document:

blocks.zh: 所選溫度/時間組合的科學依據
blocks.en: Scientific rationale for the chosen temperature/time combination

blocks.zh: 與替代方案的比較數據
blocks.en: Comparative data against alternative schemes

blocks.zh: 敏感度評估（能偵測到的最低菌量）
blocks.en: Sensitivity assessment (the lowest level of organisms that can be detected)

blocks.zh: 變更管理：任何培育條件的修改都需重新驗證
blocks.en: Change management: any change to incubation conditions requires revalidation

blocks.zh: 7.6 EM 設備資格確認
blocks.en: 7.6 Qualification of EM equipment

blocks.zh: EM 設備資格確認（qualification）確保採集到的數據是可信的、可重現的，且可溯源至已知標準。
blocks.en: Qualification of EM equipment ensures that the data collected are reliable, reproducible and traceable to known standards.

blocks.zh: 關鍵設備資格確認重點
blocks.en: Key qualification points for critical equipment

blocks.zh: 主動式空浮採樣器（Active Air Samplers）
blocks.en: Active air samplers

blocks.zh: 採樣流量（通常 100 L/min）需定期以校正過的流量計（NIST 溯源）校正
blocks.en: The sampling flow rate (typically 100 L/min) must be calibrated periodically with a calibrated flow meter (NIST-traceable)

blocks.zh: 校正頻率應依使用頻率與製造商建議設定（通常每 6–12 個月）
blocks.en: Calibration frequency should be set according to frequency of use and the manufacturer's recommendation (typically every 6–12 months)

blocks.zh: 流量不準確 = 實際採樣體積不正確 = CFU/m³ 數值失真
blocks.en: Inaccurate flow = incorrect actual sample volume = distorted CFU/m³ values

blocks.zh: 粒子計數器（Particle Counters）
blocks.en: Particle counters

blocks.zh: 採樣管（isokinetic probe）長度影響粒子計數準確性
blocks.en: The length of the sampling tubing (isokinetic probe) affects particle counting accuracy

blocks.zh: 過長或彎曲過多的管路會造成大粒子沉積，導致計數偏低
blocks.en: Tubing that is too long or has too many bends causes deposition of large particles, resulting in under-counting

blocks.zh: ISO 21501-4 規定了粒子計數器的校正要求
blocks.en: ISO 21501-4 specifies calibration requirements for particle counters

blocks.zh: 數據完整性要求
blocks.en: Data integrity requirements

blocks.zh: 現代 EM 系統越來越多採用電子數據採集與自動傳輸。TR13 特別提及 data collection, transmission, storage 和 alarm conditions，呼應 FDA 數據完整性指引（2018）的要求：
blocks.en: Modern EM systems increasingly use electronic data collection and automatic transmission. TR13 specifically mentions data collection, transmission, storage and alarm conditions, echoing the expectations of the FDA data integrity guidance (2018):

blocks.zh: 電子記錄不可刪除或覆蓋（audit trail 必須啟用）
blocks.en: Electronic records must not be deleted or overwritten (the audit trail must be enabled)

blocks.zh: 警報條件（Alert/Action Level 觸發）應有自動記錄
blocks.en: Alarm conditions (Alert/Action Level triggers) should be recorded automatically

blocks.zh: 資料備份策略應列入 EM 系統驗證範圍
blocks.en: The data backup strategy should be included in the scope of EM system validation

blocks.zh: 7.7 分析員訓練與資格確認
blocks.en: 7.7 Analyst training and qualification

blocks.zh: 人員（analyst/operator）是 EM 最重要、也最容易被忽略的變數。再完善的培養基、設備和培育策略，都無法彌補採樣技術不當所引入的人為誤差。
blocks.en: Personnel (analysts/operators) are the most important and also the most easily overlooked variable in EM. No matter how well media, equipment and incubation strategy are designed, they cannot make up for human error introduced by improper sampling technique.

blocks.zh: EM 分析員資格確認程序
blocks.en: EM analyst qualification process

blocks.zh: 初始訓練：EM 原理 → 各採樣方法 SOP → 設備操作 → 無菌技術
blocks.en: Initial training: EM principles → SOPs for each sampling method → equipment operation → aseptic technique

blocks.zh: 更衣資格確認（Gowning Qualification）：在無菌區域採樣前，必須通過無菌更衣技術評估（包含 fingertip / glove impression plates）
blocks.en: Gowning qualification: before sampling in aseptic areas, personnel must pass an assessment of aseptic gowning technique (including fingertip / glove impression plates)

blocks.zh: 採樣技術確認：實際觀察採樣操作，確認技術符合 SOP（例如接觸碟的施力、棉棒採樣區域、設備放置位置）
blocks.en: Sampling technique verification: observe actual sampling operations to confirm that technique conforms to the SOP (for example, the pressure applied to contact plates, the area sampled with swabs, and equipment placement)

blocks.zh: 定期再訓練：建議每年重新評估，或在程序變更後觸發再訓練
blocks.en: Periodic retraining: annual reassessment is recommended, and retraining should also be triggered by procedure changes

blocks.zh: 記錄保存：訓練矩陣（training matrix）需完整記錄，並可供查廠稽核
blocks.en: Record retention: the training matrix must be completely documented and available for inspection and audit

blocks.zh: 微生物學家的「風險意識」
blocks.en: The microbiologist's "risk awareness"

blocks.zh: TR13 特別強調分析員需理解「不遵守程序的品質風險與影響」。這不只是被動執行 SOP，而是主動理解每個步驟的 GMP 背景——例如：
blocks.en: TR13 specifically stresses that analysts need to understand "the quality risks and impact of not following procedures". This goes beyond passively following the SOP to actively understanding the GMP background of every step, for example:

blocks.zh: 為何採樣後不能讓培養基在室溫下放置超過規定時間？
blocks.en: Why must media not be left at room temperature after sampling for longer than the specified time?

blocks.zh: 接觸碟打開的瞬間，無菌技術不當可能引入什麼污染？
blocks.en: What contamination could improper aseptic technique introduce at the moment a contact plate is opened?

blocks.zh: 超出 Action Level 時，第一時間應採取什麼行動？
blocks.en: When an Action Level is exceeded, what action should be taken first?

blocks.zh: 8.0 參考文獻的架構意義
blocks.en: 8.0 Structure and significance of the References

blocks.zh: TR13 的 37 篇參考文獻勾勒出 EM 知識體系的完整輪廓。理解文獻的分類，有助於快速定位特定問題的規範依據。
blocks.en: The 37 references in TR13 outline the full scope of the EM body of knowledge. Understanding how the references are categorized helps you quickly locate the regulatory basis for a specific question.

blocks.zh: EM 知識體系的文獻層次
blocks.en: Levels of literature in the EM body of knowledge

blocks.zh: 法規 / 強制要求
blocks.en: Regulations / mandatory requirements

blocks.zh: 技術指引 / 最佳實務
blocks.en: Technical guidance / best practices

blocks.zh: 測試方法 / 標準
blocks.en: Test methods / standards

blocks.zh: TR13 引用的 PDA 姊妹報告
blocks.en: Sister PDA reports cited in TR13

blocks.zh: TR13 廣泛引用其他 PDA 技術報告，形成相互支撐的知識網絡：
blocks.en: TR13 cites many other PDA technical reports, forming a mutually supporting network of knowledge:

blocks.zh: TR70：清潔與消毒程序（EM 培養基中和劑選擇的背景）
blocks.en: TR70: cleaning and disinfection programs (background for selecting neutralizers in EM media)

blocks.zh: TR44：無菌製程風險管理（EM 採樣計畫的風險評估框架）
blocks.en: TR44: risk management of aseptic processes (risk assessment framework for the EM sampling plan)

blocks.zh: TR80：數據完整性管理（EM 電子記錄與 audit trail）
blocks.en: TR80: data integrity management (EM electronic records and audit trail)

blocks.zh: TR59：統計方法（EM 趨勢分析的統計基礎）
blocks.en: TR59: statistical methods (statistical basis for EM trend analysis)

blocks.zh: TR33：快速微生物學方法（替代 EM 方法的驗證依據）
blocks.en: TR33: rapid microbiological methods (basis for validating alternative EM methods)

blocks.zh: 實務建議：建立 EM SOP 的文獻矩陣
blocks.en: Practical recommendation: build a reference matrix for the EM SOP

blocks.zh: 建議藥廠在撰寫或修訂 EM SOP 時，對照 TR13 的參考文獻建立「依據文獻矩陣」，確保每項關鍵決策（培養基選擇、培育條件、警示標準設定等）都能溯源至具體的法規或技術指引條文。這在查廠時能有效展示程序的科學性與合規性。
blocks.en: When writing or revising the EM SOP, firms are advised to build a "reference matrix" against the references of TR13, so that every key decision (media selection, incubation conditions, setting of alert criteria and so on) can be traced to a specific regulatory or technical guidance provision. This effectively demonstrates the scientific soundness and compliance of the procedure during an inspection.

blocks.zh: Gordon et al. (Ref. 37) 的實踐含義
blocks.en: Practical implications of Gordon et al. (Ref. 37)

blocks.zh: 這篇 2014 年 PDA Journal 論文比較了不同培育條件對 EM 結果的影響，是 Section 7.5 最重要的科學依據之一。其核心發現提醒業界：
blocks.en: This 2014 PDA Journal paper compared the effect of different incubation conditions on EM results and is one of the most important scientific bases for Section 7.5. Its core findings remind the industry that:

blocks.zh: 培育驗證不能只做體外實驗（in vitro）——現場樣品（in situ）的微生物狀態不同
blocks.en: Incubation validation cannot rely on in vitro experiments alone, because the microorganisms in in situ samples are in a different physiological state

blocks.zh: 行業間培育條件差異大，沒有絕對「正確」方案，需個別驗證
blocks.en: Incubation conditions differ widely between companies; there is no single absolutely "correct" scheme, so each must be validated individually

blocks.zh: 驗證報告應涵蓋最差情境（worst-case organism + worst-case media exposure condition）
blocks.en: The validation report should cover the worst case (worst-case organism + worst-case media exposure condition)

blocks.zh: TR13 Section 7–8 重點總結 / Key Takeaways
blocks.en: TR13 Sections 7–8 Key Takeaways

blocks.zh: Section 7 — EM 先決條件
blocks.en: Section 7: EM prerequisites

blocks.zh: 16 項先決條件是 EM 程序的系統性基礎，缺一不可；第 14–16 項（HVAC IQ/OQ、HEPA 驗證、氣流量測）為預資格確認活動，本節不再詳述。
blocks.en: The 16 prerequisites are the systematic foundation of the EM program and none can be omitted; items 14–16 (HVAC IQ/OQ, HEPA validation, airflow measurement) are pre-qualification activities and are not described further in this section.

blocks.zh: 7.1 廠房設計：設施設計決定 EM 能達到的監控品質上限；BS EN 17141:2020 已取代 ISO 14698，更強調風險評估驅動的污染控制。
blocks.en: 7.1 Facility design: facility design determines the upper limit of monitoring quality EM can achieve; BS EN 17141:2020 has replaced ISO 14698 and places more emphasis on risk-assessment-driven contamination control.

blocks.zh: 7.2 培養基選擇：SCDM/TSA 為廣效標準基礎；表面採樣需添加中和劑；SDA 與厭氧培養基僅在特定情況下使用；每批培養基需進行 GPT 並使用環境分離株。
blocks.en: 7.2 Media selection: SCDM/TSA is the broad-spectrum standard base; surface sampling requires neutralizers; SDA and anaerobic media are used only in specific situations; every media lot must undergo GPT using environmental isolates.

blocks.zh: 7.3 促生長微生物：GPT 菌株需同時涵蓋藥典標準菌株（USP <61>）與廠房環境分離株；菌株維護應依 USP <1117> 管控傳代。
blocks.en: 7.3 Growth-promotion microorganisms: GPT strains must cover both pharmacopeial reference strains (USP <61>) and facility environmental isolates; strain maintenance should control passages in accordance with USP <1117>.

blocks.zh: 7.4 樣品保存：從採樣結束到培育開始的完整鏈路需以保存研究驗證；UV 氣閘可能損傷樣品中的目標微生物。
blocks.en: 7.4 Sample hold: the complete chain from the end of sampling to the start of incubation must be validated by a hold-time study; UV airlocks may damage target microorganisms in samples.

blocks.zh: 7.5 培育策略：雙溫方案（20–25°C → 30–35°C）為業界主流；多種方案均可接受，但需科學驗證；in vitro 結果不等於 in situ 表現。
blocks.en: 7.5 Incubation strategy: the dual-temperature scheme (20–25°C → 30–35°C) is the industry mainstream; several schemes are acceptable but must be scientifically validated; in vitro results do not equal in situ performance.

blocks.zh: 7.6 設備資格確認：採樣流量準確性與採樣管長度是關鍵參數；電子數據採集系統需納入驗證範圍並啟用 audit trail。
blocks.en: 7.6 Equipment qualification: sampling flow accuracy and sampling tubing length are key parameters; electronic data collection systems must be included in the validation scope and have the audit trail enabled.

blocks.zh: 7.7 分析員訓練：訓練不僅是 SOP 執行，更需培養對品質影響的風險意識；更衣資格確認與採樣技術評估應定期進行。
blocks.en: 7.7 Analyst training: training is more than carrying out the SOP; it must also build risk awareness of the quality impact; gowning qualification and sampling technique assessment should be performed periodically.

blocks.zh: Section 8 — 參考文獻架構
blocks.en: Section 8: Structure of the References

blocks.zh: TR13 引用 37 篇文獻，涵蓋 PDA 技術報告群、國際法規（FDA/EU/WHO/ICH）、ISO 標準（14644/14698 系列）及各國藥典（USP/EP/JP）。
blocks.en: TR13 cites 37 references, covering the PDA technical reports, international regulations (FDA/EU/WHO/ICH), ISO standards (14644/14698 series) and national pharmacopoeias (USP/EP/JP).

blocks.zh: 法規層次：FDA Aseptic Guide 2004 和 EU GMP Annex 1 是最高層強制依據；ICH Q9 提供風險管理框架。
blocks.en: Regulatory tier: the FDA Aseptic Guide 2004 and EU GMP Annex 1 are the highest-level mandatory basis; ICH Q9 provides the risk management framework.

blocks.zh: PDA 生態系：TR13 與 TR44、TR70、TR80、TR59、TR33 等相互引用，形成無菌製造知識體系的完整網絡。
blocks.en: PDA ecosystem: TR13 cross-references TR44, TR70, TR80, TR59, TR33 and others, forming a complete network of knowledge for aseptic manufacturing.

blocks.zh: 藥典方法：USP <61> 規定 GPT 菌株要求；USP <1116> 為 EM 環境監控的核心藥典章；USP <1117> 規範微生物實驗室最佳實務。
blocks.en: Pharmacopeial methods: USP <61> specifies the GPT strain requirements; USP <1116> is the core pharmacopeial chapter on EM; USP <1117> governs best practices for the microbiology laboratory.

blocks.zh: 關鍵科學論文：Gordon et al. (2014, Ref. 37) 是 7.5 培育策略的核心科學依據；Marshall et al. (1998, Ref. 34) 提供不同培育條件對酵母/黴菌回收率的比較數據。
blocks.en: Key scientific papers: Gordon et al. (2014, Ref. 37) is the core scientific basis for the 7.5 incubation strategy; Marshall et al. (1998, Ref. 34) provides comparative data on yeast/mold recovery under different incubation conditions.

blocks.zh: 建議實務：建立 EM SOP 文獻矩陣，確保每項決策均可溯源至 TR13 所引用的具體法規或技術指引。
blocks.en: Recommended practice: build an EM SOP reference matrix so that every decision can be traced to the specific regulation or technical guidance cited in TR13.

blocks.zh: BS EN 17141:2020：此新標準取代了原有 ISO 14698 系列，是廠房設計與潔淨室生物污染控制的最新 ISO 層級依據。
blocks.en: BS EN 17141:2020: this new standard replaces the former ISO 14698 series and is the latest ISO-level basis for facility design and biocontamination control in cleanrooms.
